Containers.Name: 45HomeLab
Containers.Requires: 45Drives X-15, HL-15 1.0/2.0, HL-8, HL-4, or Unraid 45Homelab X-4 system
Containers.Description: Embed the 45Drives disk map UI directly in Unraid's Main page and generate map/server metadata on the Unraid host. Standard X-15, HL-15 1.0/2.0, HL-8, HL-4, and Unraid 45Homelab X-4 systems are detected automatically. HL-15 systems with non-standard motherboard/HBA wiring may require a manual HBA phy-order override; see the project README for configuration details. Fan-lighting controls require the Unraid OpenRGB plugin, available at https://github.com/unraid/unraid-openrgb/releases/latest/download/openrgb.plg. Drive mapping works without OpenRGB.
